answer.question: What does TEAM International do for business services companies?
answer.text: TEAM International is a SaaS development company for B2B software vendors and professional services firms. We build and run HR, payroll and staffing platforms, legal and claims systems, pricing and workflow SaaS, and the support behind them, for clients such as a staffing-software leader, a U.S. payroll provider and a UK law firm.
answer.segmentsIntro: IT solutions for professional services and B2B software companies, focused on mid-size firms that need enterprise-grade engineering.

focus.title: Business services software we build and run
focus.intro: Custom SaaS development and business software in four areas, each one already in production for business services clients.

items.title: SaaS product engineering
items.text: SaaS product development for B2B vendors: new modules, multi-tenant platforms and re-platforming, as a SaaS application development company working inside your roadmap or delivering custom SaaS development end to end.
items.proof: In production: 8 applications on a B2B pricing platform, including an AI price-guidance product, and an email-signature SaaS integrated with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace (since 2020).

items.title: HR, payroll and staffing platforms
items.text: HR software development and HRMS software development: payroll engines, employee portals and HRIS integrations, plus recruitment software development for ATS features and staffing workflows.
items.proof: In production: five payroll and HR products for a U.S. payroll provider, including a multi-tenant re-platform to Azure (since 2018), and custom ATS features for a staffing-software leader (since 2018).

items.title: Legal and professional services systems
items.text: Legal software development for law firms and legal publishers: claims platforms, client questionnaires, content systems and Dynamics 365 CRM development for corporate and legal services.
items.proof: In production: a claims platform that processed 100,000+ online claims without downtime for a UK law firm, and a Dynamics 365 CRM for a corporate and legal services firm (since 2016).

items.title: Support and data for service businesses
items.text: Tiered customer and technical support for your software users, 24/7 support for SaaS platforms, and data platforms that give service firms one trusted view of operations.
items.proof: In production: customer, technical and tier 1–3 support for an email-signature SaaS and 24/7 support for a B2B pricing platform.

steps.title: How a business services engagement works
steps.intro: Every engagement starts with an assessment and fits into your existing release cadence.

items.title: Discovery & Modernization Assessment
items.text: We map your product architecture, roadmap, integrations, support load and manual work with your team.
items.outcome: A clear picture of what to build, modernize, automate or leave alone

items.title: Prioritized roadmap
items.text: We rank initiatives by customer and revenue impact, risk and effort, and agree on success metrics.
items.outcome: A roadmap product and leadership can approve

items.title: Dedicated team set-up
items.text: We staff engineering, QA, data and support roles in your time zone, inside your tools and ceremonies.
items.outcome: One accountable team that knows your product

items.title: Build, integrate and test
items.text: We deliver in short releases with automated testing and backward-compatible APIs for your customers.
items.outcome: Releases your customers don't notice, except for the new features

items.title: Run and improve
items.text: We support what we deliver and track the KPIs agreed in step 2.
items.outcome: Measurable progress you can report on

delivery.title: Your language, your market, your time zone
delivery.text: North American companies work with our Medellín delivery center; European clients work with our teams in Ukraine. All locations are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and we work under GDPR.

faq.title: SaaS and business services software: straight answers

items.q: What do SaaS development services include?
items.a: SaaS development services cover product discovery, architecture, multi-tenant development, integrations, testing, DevOps and support for software sold as a service. TEAM International provides them as a SaaS development company for B2B vendors, from new modules to full re-platforms.

items.q: What does TEAM International build for business services companies?
items.a: Four areas: SaaS product engineering; HR, payroll and staffing platforms; legal and professional services systems; and support and data for service businesses. As a SaaS software development company and HR software development company we offer SaaS application development services inside your roadmap or as end-to-end projects.

items.q: Can you work inside our existing product team and release process?
items.a: Yes. Most of our business services clients run TEAM engineers inside their own squads, tools and ceremonies, with backward-compatible releases so their customers are never disrupted.

items.q: Do you build software for law firms and legal publishers?
items.a: Yes. As a legal software development company we have built a claims platform that processed 100,000+ online claims without downtime for a UK law firm, and we run a content platform for a legal and business publisher. We also do custom legal software development and law firm software development for intake and client portals.

items.q: Can you also support our software users?
items.a: Yes. We run customer, technical and tier 1–3 support for SaaS companies, including 24/7 coverage, so your engineers stay focused on the product.

items.q: How is AI changing professional services firms?
items.a: AI tools are spreading faster than firms can govern them. Thomson Reuters' Future of Professionals 2026 survey (1,816 professionals) found that one third use unapproved AI tools and a quarter want to leave within two years if their firm doesn't provide AI tools, so firms need approved, well-integrated AI in their own systems.

items.q: Do you work with mid-size firms and software vendors?
items.a: Yes. Mid-size B2B vendors and service firms are our focus; they get the same practices we use for larger platforms, and IT solutions for professional services that fit their size.
With a Discovery & Modernization Assessment. From there you choose a dedicated team, project delivery or support, including SaaS product development services for a new product line.
